notes.title: Update Notes for 24 April 2023
notes.content:
Bugs

 Small fix where a country was unlocked but no path to it existed.

New Achievements
Request and idea from Kenpoleon Bonaparte

 Global Guardian: Visit all 139 countries in one game as the police.
 The Sneaky Traveler: Visit all 139 countries in one game as the thief.

The achievements only counts after this update. If you already visited 139 countries, you have to redo it.
Other

 Company Logo updated ingame.
